messages:
vikram_support: fyi urgent escalation from Support :warning: Acme (ACCT-197) trial onboarding is blocked — bulk embed ingest returning 429s intermittently. Demo tomorrow morning, buyer is warming up. renewal risk = high. need a CS owner to join triage + enablement call ASAP. ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-3127

toni_csm: on it. tagging @lisa_csm and @maria_successmgr. i can join triage in 15, will pull customer creds and run a quick health check. can someone paste the minimal repro?

vikram_support: repro + minimal logs below — seen ~1200 429s in 3 hours, spike after ingest retry loop kicked in:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeds -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d @batch.json
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 1
{"error":"rate_limited"}
```
link to support thread: https://support.redwood.ai/cases/9987

lisa_csm: proposed comms + triage plan: 1) toni owns customer sync (15m pre-demo triage) 2) support/eng investigate ingest throttling window (Vikram) 3) temporary workaround = smaller batches + backoff config, share snippet to customer 4) capture feedback in 1 question quick form after demo. put me down for post-demo follow-up. :white_check_mark:

maria_successmgr: add to product feedback board: "trial ingest throttling" — capture: steps tried, backlog size, expected batch size. I'll draft a 1-question survey we can send right after demo to salvage voice-of-customer.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2021009 (Embeds ingestion rate-limit spike) — assigned to eng-runtime oncall.

toni_csm: ok summary for action items — 1) toni -> join triage + start call with customer in 15 2) vikram -> share exact batch sizes and throttling timestamps in the support thread 3) lisa -> send temporary batch-size snippet to customer + schedule post-demo follow-up 4) maria -> create feedback form + add ticket to product board. will update ticket CS-3127 after triage. :pray:

vikram_support: sharing batch sizes now in support thread, will DM creds to @toni_csm. thanks team 

toni_csm: assigning owner in our tracker and will ping again if we need escalation to acct execs. going into triage now — will post brief recap here after call.
